page.content:
Forest island of Jun's chapter and Jin's Tekken 8 return.

How Yakushima connects

  • Character: Jin Kazama — Jin returns to Yakushima in Tekken 8 to face what the Devil Gene made him.
  • Character: Jun Kazama — Jun's later chapter is tied to the forests of Yakushima.

What is Yakushima?

Yakushima is the island tied to Jun Kazama and to Jin's attempt, in Tekken 8, to shed the Mishima war among cedar and coastline.

Key threads lead to Jin Kazama and Jun Kazama.
